conditions.machine: an Apple M1 Pro Mac (macOS, arm64)
conditions.cluster: Local kwok test cluster: 100 nodes, 5,415 pods, the same cluster for every row
conditions.state: Each app has its pod list open and loaded
caveats: Memory is the physical footprint that Activity Monitor shows, not PSS (macOS has none): not comparable with the Linux figures
Each value is the median of three runs; only the medians were recorded, not the smallest and largest run
conditions.notes: Measured by the project's owner with hack/bench/run.sh, three runs per app. The rows were written by hand from the reported medians, rounded as reported (memory to 1 MiB, idle CPU to 0.1%); the raw files of the runs are on the owner's machine and are not checked in, so there is no min/max. Other hosts contacted in the first minute, besides the cluster, were reported for two rows and are in other_hosts_first_minute.

rows.label: Terminal UI client
rows.notes: ran inside a minimal wrapper with no terminal app around it; a real terminal would add to its numbers
